An unnamed Southern Barrens warfront was experimented upon by Blizzard Entertainment for the release of Battle for Azeroth. It was a very early internal prototype, which served as a test bed before any of the new areas were created. It would have involved the Alliance attacking the Great Gate to Mulgore, and many unused NPC IDs were added for it, but it was never completed. Story-wise, despite the warfront not being released, it seems the Alliance still tried to reestablish Fort Triumph along Bael Modan. The Great Gate was still besieged by the Alliance.

Spawn describes the process of a mob or spawned object entering the game world. This can happen due to various causes — most mobs killed by players return after a certain time (this is called respawn), other mobs come into existence when their preconditions are met (e.g. certain attacking mobs on a patrol quest). Depleted Resource Nodes also respawn after some time. When players first enter a new area, and some time ago other players killed many mobs (e.g. to fulfill a quest), the new arrivals may easily be surprised by respawns. This effect is alleviated by the fact that right after a respawn, mobs stand still and do not attack for about 5 seconds. This gives players enough time to move out

A spawn point is a point at which a mob that has been killed will respawn after its respawn time is up. Some mobs wander around a bit; the spawn point serves as sort of a "home" or "center" around which to wander. Mobs that have aggroed on someone will leash back to their spawn points once they have nobody to fight (i.e. once their aggro list is empty), whether that is because they killed their target(s) or because their target(s) got away. Patrolling mobs will leash back to the spot they were patrolling just prior to being aggroed.

Speak with Plants is a druidic spell shared by both druids and elven rangers. A caster can comprehend and communicate with plants, including both normal plants and plant creatures. He is able to ask questions of and receive answers from plants. A regular plant’s sense of its surroundings is limited, so it won’t be able to give (or recognize) detailed descriptions of creatures or answer questions about events outside its immediate vicinity. The spell doesn’t make plant creatures any more friendly or cooperative than normal. Spawned objects are objects, parts of the in-game world, which are not always present, but spawn, fixed in place, either periodically or when some event occurs. They can be usually used. They cannot be carried by player characters, and are either permanent spawns (such as specific quest objects) or random spawns (such as chests). Spawned objects are distinguished from fixed devices in that they may disappear after use, although they may respawn in the same place later. ;Pointers for using a spawned object: : in range to use out of range ;Examples of spawned objects: *chests * player created campfire cooking fire * fishing pool ;See also: * Objects category
